verdict.rationale: Increase is a banking API product. The evidence shows REST endpoints, a dashboard, an official CLI, an llms.txt file, markdown docs and an OpenAPI spec, but nothing showing that the product itself accepts natural-language commands. The llms.txt file, OpenAPI spec and CLI are developer building blocks that an external agent could use to approximate this, which earns no credit, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
